topic: Review and synthesize empirical research from peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and credible educational reports that evaluates which academic, cognitive, or practical skills are most impacted by generative artificial intelligence tools (e.g., AI-powered writing assistants, coding tutors, language learning platforms, or content creation tools) when used by high school or secondary school students. Focus on studies that directly measure student skill acquisition or development as a result of using these tools.
